conversionIntegrityP0.trigger: https://baby.madabase.com/guides/ergobaby-omni-breeze-positions-by-age had traffic but no monetization CTA.
conversionIntegrityP0.rootCause: The guide points to ergobaby-omni-breeze-carrier, whose former ASIN B0CCNT3HLW is correctly suppressed because the Amazon listing drifted to a different two-carrier bundle. Guide and review templates had no verified-commerce fallback after that suppression. The first repair then accepted before-first-image rather than the actual first viewport, leaving the target CTA 3.8 mobile screens down.
conversionIntegrityP0.remediation: Placed a compact purchase path immediately after H1 and explicitly marked it as first-viewport commerce across Amazon guides, reviews, roundups, tools and categories, localized markets, all Style money templates, and Costume guides, categories, products and roundups. Structural audits now require the marked CTA inside the post-H1 compact container and before the first content image. Costume guides without an exact active family offer use an eligible same-category database-backed CJ fallback. A blocked exact product may use a clearly labeled verified alternative, never the original product name or an unverified ASIN.
conversionIntegrityP0.targetPage: The Omni Breeze positions-by-age guide now explicitly says the exact Omni Breeze listing is paused and offers the verified BabyBjorn Harmony alternative, ASIN B0947B35TG, with the Baby site tag madababy-20. Do not restore the exact Omni Breeze purchase claim until a current exact listing is independently verified.
